lexicon_entries.source_excerpt: Woccon yatestea, Catawba yatci, Other Siouan Lang ayusí (B) atcu:’fi (Of)

grammar_notes.text: The Woccon word 'yatestea' corresponds to the Catawba form 'yatci', and other Siouan languages show similar forms such as 'ayusí' in Biloxi and 'atcu:’fi' in Ofo. The sound correspondences can be broken down into t-č-s(B)-č(Of).
